markets.rules_primary: If Discharge Petition No. 28's highest official signature count is at least 218 signatures before 12:00 PM ET on Jan 3, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The value is the highest cumulative number of voting Members of the U.S. House of Representatives whose names the Clerk records as signers of Discharge Petition No. 28 at any time before 12:00 PM ET on Jan 3, 2027. The petition concerns a proposal to designate Afghanistan for Temporary Protected Status, which would let eligible Afghan nationals in the United States stay and work legally.

A signature counts when the Member's name appears on the official list maintained by the Clerk. If the official list reaches at least 218, a later withdrawal does not reverse that attainment. Public support, a cosponsorship, or an announced intention to sign without the Member appearing on the Clerk's official petition list does NOT count. Non-voting Delegates and the Resident Commissioner do not count.

markets.rules_primary: If the highest vote share received by any qualifying third-party candidate in a 2026 U.S. Senate election is at least 2% in the 2026 U.S. Senate elections, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A qualifying third-party candidate is a candidate recorded by the relevant state election authority under the name of a political party other than the Democratic Party, the Republican Party, or a recognized state affiliate of either (including the Minnesota Democratic-Farmer-Labor Party and the North Dakota Democratic-Nonpartisan League Party). A minor party whose registered name contains the word "Independent" (for example, the Alaskan Independence Party) qualifies. Candidates recorded as Independent, Unaffiliated, Nonaffiliated, Nonpartisan, Undeclared, No Party, No Party Preference, No Party Affiliation, or under any other non-party or petition label do not qualify. A candidate who is also the Democratic or Republican nominee does not qualify. A candidate nominated only by one or more qualifying parties qualifies, and their votes across all such lines are combined.

All U.S. Senate general elections held on November 3, 2026 are in scope, including special elections. Each qualifying candidate's figure is their share of all votes cast for that seat as certified by the relevant state election authority; in a ranked-choice contest, the first-round share is used. The market resolves on the single highest such certified share across all contests.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the House holds a recorded vote on adopting a resolution or an article of impeachment against Pete Hegseth.
markets.rules_primary: If the number of Republican Representatives voting Yea on the first House vote on adopting a resolution or article impeaching Pete Hegseth is at least 1 before Jan 3, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The vote that counts is the first recorded House vote on adopting a resolution or an article of impeachment against Pete Hegseth, whether or not the House adopts it. If the articles are voted on separately, the vote on the first article counts.

Only Yea votes by Representatives listed as Republicans in the Clerk of the House's roll call for that vote count.

Does NOT count:

A vote on a motion to table, refer, postpone or otherwise dispose of an impeachment resolution, or on a special rule or the previous question
A committee vote

If there is no such vote before Jan 3, 2027, the number is zero.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early once the Senate Democratic caucus has elected its leader for the 120th Congress.
markets.rules_primary: If the number of votes cast for Chris Van Hollen on the first ballot in the Senate Democratic caucus election for its leader for the 120th Congress is at least 8 before Jan 3, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The first ballot is the first ballot held by the Senate Democratic caucus to elect its leader for the 120th Congress. The count is the number of votes cast for Chris Van Hollen on it, as reported by a Source Agency.

The count is 0 if no ballot is held before Jan 3, 2027, including if the caucus elects its leader without one (for example by acclamation, voice vote or unanimous consent). A report that the leader was elected unanimously that gives no number and does not say a ballot was held counts as an election without a ballot, unless a Source Agency reports that a ballot was held. If Chris Van Hollen withdraws, the count is the number of votes cast for him on the first ballot, and 0 if none were cast.

Only an exact number reported by a Source Agency counts; a range, a margin or an approximate number does not. If a ballot is held but no Source Agency reports the number of votes cast for Chris Van Hollen by the Expiration Date, the market resolves to the last fair price as solely determined by the Exchange. If Source Agencies report different counts, the count reported by the Source Agency listed first is used.

The following do NOT count:
Votes cast for Chris Van Hollen on a later ballot
A motion or voice vote after a ballot to make the result unanimous
Votes cast for any other candidate, or abstentions

markets.rules_primary: If the number of distinct U.S. states JD Vance visits after Issuance is at least 1 before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The observation period begins at Issuance and ends before Jan 1, 2027. States visited before Issuance do not count.

For the purposes of this Contract, the count refers to distinct U.S. states visited as documented in official travel records, such as photo galleries, schedules and pool reports, released by the White House or the Office of the Vice President. A state counts once, no matter how many times it is visited. Washington, D.C. is not a state.

No separate official total is required: the Exchange will compile the distinct states shown in those records for the observation period, using records released before the Expiration Time.

The following do NOT constitute a visit:

Flying over the area without landing
Layovers during which the person remains in an airplane
Virtual or remote appearances
Presence in international waters adjacent to the area
Plans, announcements, or scheduling of future visits that do not occur during the applicable time period

For the avoidance of doubt, a visit occurs only when the person exits an aircraft, vehicle, vessel, or train within the area, or otherwise physically enters the area not aboard one. Remaining aboard, including during flyovers, drive-throughs, and non-exit refueling stops, does not constitute a visit. Exiting within the area constitutes a visit regardless of duration or method of exit.

markets.rules_primary: If the number of U.S. states that formally adopt a binding state-level moratorium on data-center development is at least 3 in 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A state qualifies upon final adoption of a binding law, executive order, regulation, or agency order that expressly targets data centers and prohibits or suspends a material governmental approval, permitting, interconnection, construction, expansion, or operation pathway for new or expanded data centers.

The measure may apply only to a defined class of data centers, including facilities above a specified power, water-use, computing-capacity, or size threshold, and may grandfather existing facilities or applications. It need not use the word “moratorium,” and a permanent prohibition also qualifies.

A qualifying state remains counted if the measure subsequently expires, is repealed, rescinded, superseded, or enjoined, provided it became legally operative. Local measures, project-specific holds, pending legislation, studies, reporting requirements, tax-incentive changes, and regulatory requirements that do not suspend development do not qualify.

Count as of July 21, 2026: 1 — New York. New York Executive Order 62, issued July 14, directs the Department of Environmental Conservation to hold certain incomplete discretionary-permit applications for the construction or expansion of data centers in abeyance. The order covers data centers consuming or capable of consuming at least 50 megawatts, and official state and NCSL materials identify it as the nation’s first statewide data-center moratorium.

markets.rules_primary: If the number of days the next fiscal year 2027 continuing resolution to become law funds the government beyond December 11, 2026 is at least 7 days if it becomes law before January 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The next continuing resolution is the first law, after Issuance, that provides continuing appropriations for fiscal year 2027 to the government generally: it covers at least 7 of the 12 regular fiscal year 2027 appropriations areas, counting areas that the same law or an earlier law funds for the full year. Public Law 119-103, which funds the government through Dec 11, 2026, does not count.

It can be a standalone law or a division of a broader law, and it can be enacted after a lapse in appropriations has begun.

Does NOT count:

A law continuing funding for fewer areas, or only for particular programs or activities
A regular fiscal year 2027 appropriations act
A supplemental appropriations act

The end date is the date through which the law provides continuing appropriations, as stated in its text. If the law gives different end dates to different areas, the earliest is the end date. Dates that apply only to specific programs or accounts, and extensions of authorities, are ignored.

The number of days is the number of calendar days after Dec 11, 2026 up to and including the end date. A law that funds the government through Jan 30, 2027 is 50 days.

Later continuing resolutions do not change the number. If no such law is enacted before Jan 1, 2027, the number of days is zero.
markets.title: Will the number of days the next fiscal year 2027 continuing resolution to become law funds the government beyond December 11, 2026 be at least 7 if it becomes law before January 1, 2027?

markets.rules_primary: If the U.S. suspends or revokes any Nvidia H200 export license for China after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This must be confirmed, verified, or established as factual by at least one Source Agency.

News confirmation is defined as a published article, broadcast segment, or official news report by a Source Agency, that A) explicitly states a U.S. suspension or revocation of any Nvidia H200 export license for China occurred, is true, or has been verified, B) based on journalistic investigation, sources, or evidence, and C) presented as factual reporting rather than speculation, rumor, or unverified allegation.

A suspension or revocation occurs when the U.S. Department of Commerce, the President, or an enacted federal law suspends, revokes, or withdraws at least one license or approval to export Nvidia H200 chips to China or a Chinese customer, including a general halt of H200 exports to China by any form of order or notice, whether or not the government announces it.

The following do NOT count:
Denying or pausing new or pending applications, or adding conditions, while existing licenses remain valid
A license expiring by its own terms
Nvidia, a distributor, a customer, or China itself stopping shipments, orders, or imports
A request, bill, or threat that has not been carried out
Restrictions on other chips, such as the H20, Blackwell, or Rubin

markets.rules_primary: If Gavin Newsom calls a new special session of the California Legislature before January 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A qualifying call is a new official proclamation by Gavin Newsom under Article IV, Section 3(b) of the California Constitution calling the California Legislature into special or extraordinary session. Any subject qualifies. The proclamation must be issued after Issuance and before January 1, 2027; the Legislature need not meet before that deadline.

An amendment that only adds subjects to an already-called session does not constitute a new call. Legislative requests, proposals, and announcements of plans to call a session do not qualify without the proclamation.

The number of new special sessions of the California Legislature called by Gavin Newsom is counted from the Office of the Governor of California's official proclamation record. A record showing no qualifying call establishes a count of zero. If the official data needed to determine the count is unavailable by expiration, the contract's no-data provision applies.

markets.rules_primary: If the number of Trump Cabinet members who leave or announce they will leave is at least 1 after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For purposes of this Contract, the Cabinet includes the heads of the 15 government agencies in the Cabinet as of Issuance, as well as the Administrator of the EPA, the President’s Chief of Staff, Director of National Intelligence, Director of OMB, Director of CIA, United States Trade Representative, Ambassador to the UN, Chair of the Council of Economic Advisers, Administrator of the SBA, and Director of OSTP. Acting roles are not included.

Each person who leaves one of these positions, or announces they will leave it, after Issuance counts once. A person’s announcement of their intent to leave and their departure count as one occurrence, at the earlier of the two. The President announcing that a member of the Cabinet will leave the Cabinet also qualifies.

A person who begins serving in one of these positions after Issuance, including Stephen Miller as Chief of Staff, counts if they later leave it. Moving directly from one of these positions to another does not count.

A leave of absence does not constitute leaving the position. Leaving office as a result of death is not encompassed by the Payout Criterion.

markets.rules_primary: If Chuck Schumer is reelected Senate Democratic leader for the 120th Congress by voice vote, acclamation or without objection before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Election as Senate Democratic leader means election to lead the Senate Democratic Caucus for the 120th Congress, whether the post is styled Democratic Leader or Majority Leader. The count is 1 if the Source Agencies report that Chuck Schumer was elected by voice vote, by acclamation or without objection, and 0 otherwise, including if no such election is held before Jan 1, 2027. An election by unanimous consent counts as an election without objection.

The following do NOT count:
An election in which senators cast ballots, whether secret or recorded, even if the result is unanimous
A ballot followed by a motion to make the result unanimous or to approve Chuck Schumer by acclamation
A report that Chuck Schumer was elected unanimously, or without opposition, that does not say the election was by voice vote, acclamation, without objection or by unanimous consent
A statement before the election about how it is expected to be held

If Source Agencies disagree on the method, a report by any Source Agency that a ballot was cast governs.

markets.rules_primary: If the percent increase in the daily minimum wage in Mexico's Northern Border Free Zone is at least 5% for 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved

The border-zone minimum wage is the daily minimum wage CONASAMI sets for the Northern Border Free Zone (Zona Libre de la Frontera Norte), not the general zone (resto del país).
The percent increase is the daily peso amount fixed for 2027 divided by 440.87 pesos, the amount fixed for 2026, minus one, expressed as a percentage and rounded half-up to one decimal place.
The 2027 amount is the one stated in the resolution of CONASAMI's Consejo de Representantes fixing the minimum wages for 2027, as first published by CONASAMI or in the Diario Oficial de la Federación, whichever is first. Later amendments or corrections do NOT count.

Payout criteria

If a percentage stated in the resolution or announced by officials differs from the percentage computed from the peso amounts, the computed percentage governs.
Any Monto Independiente de Recuperación (MIR) is part of the peso amount and is not computed separately.

Examples:

A resolution fixing 462.91 pesos is a 5.0% increase (462.91 ÷ 440.87 - 1 = 4.9992%, rounded) → resolves to Yes for at least 5%
An announced increase of 5% with a resolution amount of 462.00 pesos (4.8%) → resolves to No for at least 5%

A party is first if it has the highest percentage shown for the most recent date in the default view of the Parliament voting intention chart on POLITICO’s Poll of Polls page for the United Kingdom, as displayed at 10:00 AM ET on Dec 31, 2026, whether or not that date is Dec 31. Percentages are compared as displayed, in whole numbers, and every party shown on the chart is ranked.

If two or more parties are tied for the highest displayed percentage, each tied strike will receive 1/N of the Settlement Value, where N is the number of tied strikes.

Individual polls, seat projections, approval ratings and later revisions to the chart do NOT count.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the official vote count is certified.
markets.rules_primary: If the total vote count in the 2026 U.S. House of Representatives elections is 89,999,999 and below, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The vote count refers to the officially certified results from the relevant election authority. Provisional, absentee, early, mail-in, or electronic ballots are included only if reflected in the official certification. In preferential or ranked-choice systems, the contract resolves based on the vote count identified as the official result by the certifying authority. If the election is held in multiple phases, the contract resolves on the certified aggregate total. If a runoff forms part of the certified result, it is encompassed. The contract resolves based on officially certified results regardless of ongoing appeals. Preliminary counts, exit polls, projections, or uncertified results do not qualify. If the election is postponed but held within one year of the originally scheduled date, the contract remains valid; if postponed beyond one year or canceled, all contracts resolve to No.

markets.rules_primary: If the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam wins the next Greater Chennai Corporation election, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The winner is the party that wins the most wards of the Greater Chennai Corporation council, as declared by the Tamil Nadu State Election Commission. A ward counts for the party whose symbol the winning candidate contested on. Alliances are not combined, and independents count for no party. Only the next general election to the council counts, not a by-election. If two parties win the same number of wards, the one with the higher share of valid votes across all wards resolves Yes and all others resolve No.

markets.rules_primary: If the number of Democratic U.S. House members elected from the 235 districts that Donald Trump carried in 2024 is at least 10 at the November 3, 2026 general election, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The qualifying districts are the 235 in which Trump received more votes than Harris in 2024, as calculated by The Downballot in its 2024 presidential results by congressional district table, for the district boundaries in use at the 2026 elections. That list is fixed as of Issuance and identified by state and district number, so later boundary changes and revisions to the 2024 vote totals do NOT add or remove districts.

A district counts only if the candidate elected there at the November 3, 2026 general election, for the term beginning January 3, 2027, is listed on the ballot as a Democrat (including Minnesota's Democratic-Farmer-Labor Party), including as preferring the Democratic Party where a state uses an open, top-two or top-four ballot. If a runoff is required to determine the winner of any race, the runoff result governs. Independent and third-party winners do NOT count, even if they caucus with Democrats.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the government is officially formed.
markets.rules_primary: If a coalition that includes National makes up the next elected ruling government of New Zealand before Mar 15, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market is not mutually exclusive and multiple markets may resolve to Yes.

A party is considered to be part of government if one or more of its representatives hold at least one ministerial or cabinet-level position (including junior ministers or equivalent executive roles, if applicable) in the new government. This evaluation shall occur at the first official, stable formation of the government (i.e., once the legislative process for forming a government is complete and the head of state appoints ministers under normal non-caretaker circumstances).

A party governing alone qualifies under this ministerial-position test.

A confidence and supply arrangement (or any analogous agreement), where a party does not hold formal cabinet or ministerial positions but has publicly agreed, through a formal written agreement or a widely recognized, explicitly stated political deal, to support the government on key votes (e.g., votes of confidence, budget/finance bills) without formally joining the cabinet or government, counts only when expressly specified in the market’s party description. These individual-party descriptions do not specify such an arrangement, so confidence and supply without a qualifying ministerial position does not count.

If, following the election, a caretaker or interim government is appointed temporarily before the formal government formation, this caretaker period does not count for determining a given party’s status.

A party governing alone qualifies under this ministerial-position test.

A confidence and supply arrangement (or any analogous agreement), where a party does not hold formal cabinet or ministerial positions but has publicly agreed, through a formal written agreement or a widely recognized, explicitly stated political deal, to support the government on key votes (e.g., votes of confidence, budget/finance bills) without formally joining the cabinet or government, counts only when expressly specified in the market’s party description. These individual-party descriptions do not specify such an arrangement, so confidence and supply without a qualifying ministerial position does not count.

If, following the election, a caretaker or interim government is appointed temporarily before the formal government formation, this caretaker period does not count for determining a given party’s status.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event described in the Payout Criterion occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If the Knesset approves a new government in a vote of confidence before Dec 23, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The President tasking a candidate with forming a government, any extension of that mandate, a signed coalition agreement, an announced agreement in principle between parties, an announcement or scheduling of a confidence vote, and the continued operation of the outgoing caretaker government do NOT qualify. Neither does the swearing-in of individual ministers before the Knesset has voted.

For purposes of this market, only the Knesset's approval of a new government in a vote of confidence qualifies.

The following do NOT qualify:

Preliminary discussions, negotiations, or expressions of interest without commitment
Conditional agreements contingent on specified circumstances
Statements by opposition parties or unauthorized representatives
Leaked documents or unofficial reports not confirmed by government sources
Proposals or draft legislation without formal approval or adoption
Retraction or reversal of a previously announced commitment

Where the statutory mandate periods expire without the Knesset having approved a new government, every market resolves to NO, including where that triggers a fresh election.
markets.title: Will Israel agree to or announce a Knesset vote of confidence in a new government before Dec 23, 2026?

markets.rules_primary: If the number of Democratic U.S. House members elected from Alabama, Georgia, Louisiana, Mississippi and South Carolina is at least 9 at the November 3, 2026 general election, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The qualifying districts are the 38 U.S. House districts in Alabama (7), Georgia (14), Louisiana (6), Mississippi (4) and South Carolina (7), under the district boundaries in use at the 2026 elections.

A district counts only if the candidate elected there at the Nov 3, 2026 general election, for the term beginning Jan 3, 2027, is listed on the ballot as a Democrat, including as preferring the Democratic Party where a state uses an open, top-two or top-four ballot. If a runoff is required to determine the winner of any race, the runoff result governs. In Louisiana, the Nov 3, 2026 open primary counts as the general election and its Dec 12, 2026 runoff counts as a runoff. Independent and third-party winners do NOT count, even if they caucus with Democrats.

markets.rules_primary: If Jair Bolsonaro receives a pardon, clemency, or substantially equivalent official act of legal forgiveness from a competent authority before Jan 10, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: A pardon, commutation, amnesty or other clemency from a competent authority counts, including a partial pardon that reduces Jair Bolsonaro's sentence and a blanket or categorical act that covers Jair Bolsonaro without naming them. Any other official act by a competent authority that legally forgives, nullifies, or substantially reduces the legal consequences of Jair Bolsonaro's conviction or charges also counts. It must be officially granted, announced, or take legal effect before Jan 10, 2027, and it counts even if it is later revoked. Dropped charges, acquittals, overturned convictions, plea agreements, expungements, and pardons that are only proposed or promised do not count.
